title: Organisations outside the city: paid by Washington and by the City
question: Which City-paid organisations based outside San Francisco also take large federal awards directly, and how big are the two streams?
finding: Of the 83 City-paid organisations based outside San Francisco, 34 have direct federal awards (not loans) with award activity in fiscal 2019-2026, $4.02 billion in all. 20 took at least $1 million from both: $3.74 billion federal (most of it to four national research, health and lending bodies with little City money) and $383.8 million from the City in fiscal 2020-2026. The largest overlaps: Seneca Family of Agencies ($86.8 million federal, $74.8 million City); Abode Services ($41.4 million federal, $74.1 million City); Mercy Housing California ($64.7 million federal, $27.1 million City); Native American Health Center ($47.1 million federal, $16.4 million City); Lutheran Social Services of Northern Cal ($11.3 million federal, $30.2 million City). None of the $41.4 million in federal homelessness (Continuum of Care) grants to 3 of these organisations carries San Francisco's continuum code, which is on every one of the City's own 1,047 such award ids.
how: USAspending prime-award rows kept by the download's own name rule, then kept here only where the recipient is in California, carries an identifier (UEI) already tied to the organisation, or, for organisations with no California rows, carries their main identifier; same-name rows in other states with no shared identifier are set aside as namesakes (see that screen). Award amount is the obligated amount on the award, which can span years before 2019. City payments are fiscal 2020-2026 from the project's payment table, matched on the supplier or IRS name.
limits: Taking federal and City money at once is common for regional and national nonprofits; it only matters if the same cost is billed twice, which needs each grant's budget. Most of these federal awards fund work in other counties or nationally (the place of performance is given only as the state). Award amounts are obligations over the life of the award, not money paid in these years. A name match can still be a different body with the same name.
